dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable selectors, incompatibility checks, help example, and the no-selector/exporter path are reachable.
evidence: product.diff: item-list flags and PreRunE hunk

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive matching and actionable unknown-field errors are present, but ambiguous IDs retain input/API order rather than being sorted deterministically.

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: Initial definitions are reused and additional definition/value pages are fetched only as needed; the supplied package test command passed.
evidence: product.diff: selectedFields, CompleteProjectFields, and CompleteProjectItemFieldValues hunks

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All requested value-type renderers and empty fallbacks are visible, but CR/LF normalization is not visible before table insertion.

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Headers follow selected canonical fields, values are found by field ID, and missing values yield empty cells; the supplied item-list package test passed.

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Selection and pagination failures return before rendering, and the focused changes use existing query/client and table helpers.
evidence: product.diff: runList, selectedFields, and completeSelectedFieldValues hunks

criticalGaps: Ambiguous field-ID candidates are not deterministically sorted.
Selected values have no visible carriage-return/newline normalization.
